shot: Ellis pops in on the felt
text: Hi! I'm Ellis. Welcome to WordPoker.

shot: classic: the deal, your two tiles
text: It's Texas Hold'em... except you're dealt letters.

shot: classic: flop, turn, river, chips into the pot
text: Bet the flop. The turn. The river.

shot: classic: tapping H, E, M, P into the rack
text: Then spell the best word you can.

shot: classic: the rack, letter values and the 2× E
text: Every letter is worth points. Use a double or triple letter, and it counts two or three times.

shot: classic: HEMP broken down tile by tile, = 15, the pot
text: H is five. The doubled E makes two. M and P are four each. That's fifteen! Best word takes the pot.

shot: wild: lobby Wild Power chip, the Power Draw and the Vowel Magnet swap
text: Want chaos? Switch to Wild Power mode: power-ups that bend the rules.

shot: social: friends list (Join, Invite, Nudge), online lobby with live tables
text: Play online with your friends... or invite them to your table.

shot: story: Kitchen Table chapter map with Ellis, First Hand, the coached table
text: New here? Join me in Story mode. I will teach you the ropes.

shot: quests board with coin rewards, then the store tile sets
text: Clear daily quests, earn coins, and unlock new tile sets.

shot: end card: logo, Join the iOS beta
text: WordPoker is in beta on TestFlight. Come take my chips!
